name: Wildcat Ridge
goal: Re-sample the fine-grained, sulfate- and clay-rich layers where Perseverance cored Hazeltop and Bearwallow; best odds of preserved organics.

name: Berea
goal: Collect carbonate-rich river sandstone from the upper fan (Melyn core site) to date and trace past water.

name: Hidden Harbor
goal: Map the anhydrite veins in light-toned sandstone at the Kukaklek core site and sample vein-free rock.

name: Amalik
goal: Sample the dark coarse mudstone at the base of the fan (Shuyak and Mageik core site) for carbonates and detrital grains.
